body.name: Observed-panel law map
body.construction: For \(\theta\in\Theta_n\), define \(\mathsf P_n(\theta)=P_\theta\) as the pushforward of \(\mathsf Q_{\varepsilon}\) under \(Y_t=(a_{0\ell},A_{\ell\cdot})^{\prime}+\varepsilon_t\) for every pre-treatment \(t\) in block \(\ell\), and \(Y_{D,t}=d+\varepsilon_{D,t}\) for the \(T_1\) observed donor-only post-treatment dates, with the target post coordinate projected out. Equip \(\Theta_n\) with the product Borel sigma-field generated by Euclidean signal coordinates and finite-dimensional cylinder probabilities of \(\mathsf Q_{\varepsilon}\), and equip panel laws with the evaluation sigma-field.
